//: Voice-as-character-design example. The `assets` stage writes voice.profile (and project.narrator.profile) as part of the character design; a human or the agent then picks a provider voiceId that fits each brief. Stage options remain as per-run overrides. The narrator is kept out of the drama: never mixed into a shot that has a line, and only ever heard in the opening and closing shots of the cut.

characterExcerpt.name: 林默
characterExcerpt.appearance: male, mid-20s, lean build, tired eyes, dark windbreaker
characterExcerpt.personality: 警觉、寡言，被逼到墙角才爆发

voice.profile: 二十多岁男声，偏沙哑，语速快，紧绷警觉

narrator.profile: 中年男声，低沉平稳，纪录片质感，语速慢——与所有角色音明显区分

dubStageConfig.//: No voices/narratorVoice needed when characters and narrator are already cast in the project. Options below OVERRIDE the designed casting for one run (e.g. switching speech providers) without editing any character. narrationOpening/ClosingShots widen the only zones where the narrator may speak; a shot carrying dialogue is voiced by that character alone regardless.

agentUsage.//: The agent can cast a voice that fits the brief without touching config files.

args.name: 王队长
args.voiceProfile: 四十岁男声，沉稳有威，语速中等

narrationPlacementExample.//: Shots in playback order. Only the head and tail may carry narration; ep1-s02 would be reported by voice-check and skipped by dub.

ep1-s02.narration: 他不知道自己被盯上了。
ep1-s02.verdict: SKIPPED — 片中不使用旁白音

ep1-s03.verdict: 只说台词，旁白被丢弃 — 有对白不混旁白音
